notes: The 3D view now places every OpenStreetMap building in the area instead of a thinned sample, at its true footprint, with height from its mapped floors where OpenStreetMap has them
All mapped buildings are now included: no more 30,000 cap per city (Erbil has about 98,000, Najaf 55,000, Baghdad 41,500), and buildings mapped as multipolygons are now picked up too
Streets and routes in 3D are drawn at realistic widths so they no longer cover the buildings beside them; you can zoom in closer to street level
